categories.name: Form W-2
categories.description: Employee wage and tax statement; not a pay stub or Form W-2c.
categories.distinguishing_evidence: Form W-2; Wage and Tax Statement; numbered wages and withholding boxes.
categories.continuation_characteristics: Keep a continuation with its employee statement; a new employee statement starts a new document.

categories.name: Form 1099
categories.description: A printed 1099 information return. Preserve its subtype; do not assume all forms are 1099-NEC.
categories.distinguishing_evidence: Form 1099 followed by its subtype; PAYER and RECIPIENT blocks and labeled payment boxes.
categories.continuation_characteristics: Keep continuation details with the same return; a new payer/recipient return starts a new document.

categories.name: Promissory Note
categories.description: Borrower's written promise to repay a lender, with principal and repayment terms.
categories.distinguishing_evidence: Promissory Note or NOTE; promise to pay; principal, interest and payment terms.
categories.continuation_characteristics: Numbered terms, default/prepayment clauses, signature pages and referenced riders can continue the same note without repeating its title.

fields.name: form_type
fields.description: Exact printed 1099 subtype, for example Form 1099-NEC, Form 1099-INT or Form 1099-MISC.

fields.name: tax_year
fields.description: Tax year printed on the form.

fields.name: payer_name
fields.description: PAYER'S name; do not substitute the recipient's name.

fields.name: payer_street_address
fields.description: PAYER'S street address, including apartment/suite and any second street line; exclude city, state and ZIP.
fields.guidance: Look in the payer name/address block, including lines immediately below the payer name. Return null only if not visible in the provided content.

fields.name: payer_city
fields.description: City in the payer address block.

fields.name: payer_state
fields.description: State or province in the payer address block as printed.

fields.name: payer_postal_code
fields.description: ZIP or postal code in the payer address block.

fields.name: payer_country
fields.description: Country in the payer address block, only when explicitly printed.

fields.name: payer_tin
fields.description: Payer's taxpayer identification number.
fields.guidance: Keep printed masking; never reconstruct hidden digits.

fields.name: recipient_name
fields.description: RECIPIENT'S name.

fields.name: recipient_tin
fields.description: Recipient's taxpayer identification number.

fields.name: recipient_street_address
fields.description: Recipient street address including apartment/unit; exclude city, state and ZIP.

fields.name: recipient_city
fields.description: City in the recipient address block.

fields.name: recipient_state
fields.description: State or province in the recipient address block as printed.

fields.name: recipient_postal_code
fields.description: ZIP or postal code in the recipient address block.

fields.name: account_number
fields.description: Account number printed on the form, retaining any masking.

fields.name: reported_amounts
fields.description: Every populated monetary box on this 1099 form, preserving its printed box number and label.
fields.guidance: Return an array of objects with keys box_number, label, amount and row_label. Copy box numbers, labels and amounts verbatim. Use row_label for a printed state/local identifier, otherwise null. One entry per populated amount; no totals, blank boxes, or merging across rows. A box number means different things on different 1099 subtypes: follow the actual label.

fields.name: note_date
fields.description: Date the promissory note is made or executed, if explicitly printed.

fields.name: borrower_name
fields.description: Named borrower or borrowers as printed, preserving multiple names.

fields.name: lender_name
fields.description: Named lender or payee as printed.

fields.name: principal_amount
fields.description: Original principal amount promised in this note.
fields.guidance: Use the numeric original principal; do not substitute a payment, balance or fee.

fields.name: interest_rate
fields.description: Stated annual interest rate, if explicitly printed.
fields.guidance: Copy the stated rate; do not derive an effective rate or infer a variable rate.

fields.name: interest_terms
fields.description: Printed clause describing fixed/variable interest and any index or adjustment terms.

fields.name: payment_amount
fields.description: Stated regular installment amount, if any.

fields.name: payment_frequency
fields.description: Printed payment frequency, such as monthly; do not derive from dates.

fields.name: first_payment_date
fields.description: Explicit first payment due date.

fields.name: maturity_date
fields.description: Explicit maturity or final payment date.

fields.name: late_charge_terms
fields.description: Printed late-charge amount, percentage, grace period and conditions.

fields.name: prepayment_terms
fields.description: Printed prepayment rights or penalty clause.

fields.name: collateral_description
fields.description: Explicit description of collateral securing this note; null if not stated.

fields.name: governing_law
fields.description: Governing state/jurisdiction explicitly stated in the note.

fields.name: loan_number
fields.description: Printed loan or note identifier, if present.
